generation_fit: This is fictional and symbolic UI artwork for a scripted GUI and does not depict a real person, place, event, or archival object. Built-in ImageGen is the approved source mode for this illustrated background panel.

generation_record.edit_purpose: Removed bottom-center inset lines and corner hardware that could read as controls or decorative wells while preserving the richer paper, drafting, frame, and central seal treatment.

canonical_reference.note: The canonical library has no dedicated scripted-GUI or UI-panel family. The report-art family was inspected only for subdued period paper and restrained dossier surface treatment; no vanilla art was copied, traced, recolored, or reused.

visual_notes: Dark charcoal/brass frame uses continuous beveled edge shading and shallow panel bands without corner hardware or bottom-center controls.
The paper field is richer than the previous flat parchment through fine grain, faint fold seams, field-map/grid drafting marks, and restrained red/steel traces.
One understated central muster compass seal is blended into the paper and remains subordinate to parent-owned GUI overlays.
The center remains broad and open; no words, pseudo-text, people, portraits, vehicles, buttons, slots, wells, cards, rails, controls, or decorative compartments are present.
The processed preview preserves the generated composition at the exact 960x640 target size.
